_note: EXAMPLE ONLY — not part of the skill's method. A worked 2-page board used to validate the engine reproduces the v2 layout. Your project's spec replaces this entirely. Note the jtbds below: they are deliberately written progress-shaped and persona-attached (Q13). An earlier draft of this same example had feature-shaped jobs ('One place to work all my leads — keep every one moving, stop losing follow-ups') and it is exactly what the job gate exists to reject.
title: Page-brief — Casa Financeira (validation: 2 pages)

JTBD-1.statement: When a lead is in my hands, I want fluid control over it and over any opportunity that may come from it, so I can keep it moving without carrying it in my head.

JTBD-2.statement: When I'm accountable for the operation, I want to hold the whole thing from one screen, so I can feel it slipping before anyone tells me.

JTBD-3.statement: When someone becomes a contact, I want to know I can work them legally right now, so I can act without second-guessing whether I'm allowed to.

JTBD-4.statement: When work arrives unowned, I want it to land with someone who can actually serve it, so I can trust nothing is quietly sitting still.

JTBD-5.statement: When we hold regulated client data, I want to know exactly who can see and touch it, so I can put the firm's name behind this platform.

pages.name: Lead detail
pages.responsibilities: Give the consultant one place to see and advance every opportunity on a lead across verticals — with its consent and origin context — without leaving for the product platforms. (Variant: managers see a permission-filtered, read-mostly view.)

checklist.text: Show every opportunity on the lead, across verticals, with its state
Let the consultant open each opportunity's working screen
Reach the lead's conversation thread without leaving the CRM
Offer agent assistance (read/interpret) over the lead
Let the consultant spawn a cross-sell opportunity
Surface RGPD consent state so it's clear the lead is workable
Show attribution / origin context for the lead
Enforce per-team RBAC — see only your own opportunity
Let a manager read the lead across verticals in one pass

connects.note: non-navigational handoff — leaves for the channel
triggers ANOTHER job — spawns an opportunity and re-enters routing

factual: Opportunity states per vertical are shown (Crédito · Avaliação, Seguro · Atribuída)
RGPD consent status is visible before any action is offered
Attribution is shown: canal · ponto de entrada · selo
A team sees only its own opportunity (RBAC enforced in the view, not just the API)
qualitative: Can you tell me which opportunities are on this lead, and which vertical each belongs to?
Can you tell me whether you're allowed to work this lead right now?
Can you tell me where this lead came from?
Which opportunity would you pick up first, and why?

pages.name: Credit process
pages.route: app#/leads/:id/credito/:oppId · view-only mirror of Portal PE
pages.responsibilities: Give the consultant the full working surface for ONE credit opportunity — the PE pipeline state (read-only), plus the people, documents, proposals and follow-ups needed to move it — mirrored from Portal Grupo PE so they never leave the CRM.

checklist.text: Show the current PE pipeline stage (of 14), read-only
Let the consultant capture follow-up tasks
Manage the document dossier + expose agent doc-analysis
Show bank proposals (PE + manual) for the decision
Let the consultant record notes / next steps
Show the Seguro side of this client alongside the credit
checklist.flag: serves an unlisted job? — Seguro is a different product; is this a cross-sell job we never wrote down, or does it belong on its own page?

connects.note: manager action — different job and actor

factual: Current stage (of 14) is shown and is unmistakably read-only
Proponentes are listed with their role (co-titular / fiador)
Each bank proposal shows its origin (Portal PE vs manual upload)
qualitative: Can you tell me what was requested, and how much?
Can you tell me where in the process this is, without asking anyone?
Can you quickly see who the proponentes are?
Can you compare the bank proposals and say which is better?
